view.lint.summary: Local checks · Agent deep lint · fixes
view.dashboard.emptyState: Compact panes will show project health, recent pages, import state, Agent/BYOK availability, index state, graph state, and recent tasks.
view.wiki.emptyState: This surface will host the file tree, Markdown reader, WYSIWYG editor, save state, and external modification conflict path.
view.chat.emptyState: This surface will host chat sessions, cited answers, source links, cancelable runs, and save-to-wiki actions.
view.graph.emptyState: This surface will host the sigma.js canvas, search and filter controls, layout actions, and selected node navigation.
view.agent.emptyState: This surface will host detected CLIs, default binding, stdout and stderr logs, task status, and cancellation controls.
view.import.emptyState: This surface will host file selection, parse status, extracted previews, conflicts, and explicit compile confirmation.
view.lint.emptyState: This surface will host local deterministic findings, Agent deep lint, severity groups, evidence, and safe fix planning.
view.exports.emptyState: This surface will host prior exports, source paths, output paths, preview, regenerate, and open-folder controls.
view.settings.emptyState: This surface will host language, theme, Agent, provider, security, background task, and update preferences.
view.shared.gitSafetyCopy: Destructive, overwrite, batch rewrite, conflict merge, and Agent auto-fix flows require checkpoints.
view.shared.localFilesCopy: Project content remains Markdown, JSON, and local files under the selected project folder.
view.shared.taskStateCopy: Long work is tracked as background tasks with logs, progress, and cancellation where possible.
